# CANDIDATE: VWAP_VOLUME_NODE_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price tends to find support at VWAP when it coincides with a recent high-volume node, reflecting latent institutional interest. A pullback to VWAP accompanied by elevated volume and oversold RSI offers a mean‑reversion long edge distinct from continuation‑based VWAP strategies.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** On a 5‑minute bar, if (1) price is within 0.05% of the VWAP, (2) bar volume ≥ 1.8× the 20‑period average volume, and (3) RSI(14) ≤ 40, then go long at the bar’s close.  
**Exit:** Initial chart‑stop placed below the low of the entry bar (structure). First target (TP1) at 1.75× risk from entry. After TP1 is hit, trail the remaining runner with a chandelier exit (ATR×2.5). Regime filters: VIX 13‑20, midday window 10:30‑14:00 ET, avoid first/last 30 min of session.
